newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche sees no MGAM cash woes from fund outflows.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche sees no MGAM cash woes from fund outflows.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Monday that its UK unit Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Asset Management had sufficient cash to cover fund outflows and that it expected those outflows to decline.
Deutsche Bank spokesman Detlev Rahmsdorf said a further seven percent of three MGAM funds had been sold off on Friday but that there was no reason for the selling to continue.
"We expect the outflows will continue to decline," Rahmsdorf said.

Deutsche last week injected 180 million stg into the funds but that failed to stop investors selling off eight percent of the funds -- which are worth 1.14 billion stg -- when trading resumed on Thursday.
